text: Stalwart. Kingpin cannot be dealt damage or have upgrades attached. (The players must garner Public Support to face him directly.) [star] Forced Interrupt: When Kingpin would attack you, he schemes instead.

name: Kingpin
text: Steady. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Kingpin activates against you, if you are not engaged with a minion, give Kingpin 1 additional boost card for this activation and this activation gains overkill if it is an attack.

name: The King's Gambit
text: Contents: Kingpin (A1). (Kingpin (B1) instead for expert mode.) Kingpin encounter set. Two modular encounter sets (Tombstone and Tracksuit Mafia). Setup: Each player reveals their set-aside nemesis minion. Each player whose nemesis minion shares a title with a character in play instead removes their nemesis minion from the game, then finds an [[Underling]] minion that is not in play and reveals it.

name: The King's Gambit
text: When Revealed: Put Public Support into play, [[Low]] side faceup. Hero Action: Remove 5 threat from here (4 threat instead in expert mode). Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck, then discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a minion is discarded and reveal that minion. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

flavor: "Enough games. I want these do-gooders dealt with. Permanently!" —Kingpin
name: Endgame
text: When Revealed: Each player finds their nemesis minion and reveals it. Each player whose nemesis minion did not enter play this way finds an [[Underling]] minion that is not in play and reveals it. In expert mode, the first player finds and reveals the Organized Crime side scheme.

flavor: "You so-called heroes have been a thorn in all of our sides for far too long. Together we will destroy you and rule this city!" —Kingpin
name: Endgame
text: Each minion gains guard. If this stage is completed, the players lose the game.

name: Public Support
text: Forced Response: After a minion is defeated, place 1 support counter here. Forced Interrupt: When the villain phase begins, if there are at least 2[per_hero]+2 support counters here, flip Kingpin and advance the main scheme to stage 2A. Then, flip this card.

flavor: "So nice of them to show some gratitude! For once." —Jessica Jones
name: Public Support
text: Interrupt: When an enemy would be given a facedown boost card, remove 1[per_hero] support counters from here instead. Forced Response: After a minion is defeated, place 1 support counter here.

name: Bear Hug
text: If Kingpin has the [[Martial Artist]] trait, attach to your hero. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Uses (3 grip counters). You cannot change to alter-ego form. Forced Interrupt: When you would thwart or attack, remove 1 grip counter from here instead.

name: James Wesley
text:
When Revealed: Attach to Kingpin and give him a facedown boost card. Hero Action: Discard a [[Thwart]] event from your hand → discard James Wesley. Kingpin schemes.
[star] Boost: Attach this card to Kingpin.

name: Kingpin's Cane
text:
When Revealed: Attach to Kingpin. You are stunned. Forced Response: After Kingpin attacks and damages a hero, stun that hero. If a hero is stunned this way, discard this card.
[star] Boost: You are stunned. If you were already stunned, take 1 damage.

name: Mountain of Muscle
text: If Kingpin has the [[Martial Artist]] trait, attach to Kingpin. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Kingpin gains retaliate 1. Forced Interrupt: When Kingpin would take any amount of damage, place it here instead. Then, if there is 8 or more damage here, discard this card.

name: Vanessa Fisk
text:
When Revealed: Attach to Kingpin. You are confused. Hero Action: Discard an [[Attack]] event from your hand → discard Vanessa Fisk. Kingpin attacks you.
[star] Boost: You are confused. If you were already confused, place 1 threat on the main scheme.

name: Black Cat
text: Villainous. While there is 4 threat here, treat Black Cat as an ally that takes 2 consequential damage after she attacks or thwarts. Hero Action: Spend a [mental] resource → place 1 threat here. If there is 4 threat here, take control of Black Cat as an ally.

name: Diamondback
text:
Villainous. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Diamondback attacks you, take 1 damage.
[star] Boost: Take 1 damage.

name: Spot
text: Enters play with 1 spot counter on him. Forced Interrupt: When Spot would be dealt damage from an attack, if there is at least 1 spot counter here, remove 1 spot counter from here and deal that damage to the attacker instead. Otherwise, place 1 spot counter here.

name: Stilt-Man
text: Enters play with 2 stilt counters on him. [star] Stilt-Man gets +1 SCH and +1 ATK for each stilt counter on him. Forced Interrupt: When Stilt-Man would take any amount of damage, remove 1 stilt counter from him instead.

flavor: Kingpin uses a combination of lies, bribes, and threats to get others to do his bidding.
name: Kingpin's Influence
text: When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme places 3 threat on their nemesis side scheme. If it is not in play, they find it and reveal it.

flavor: "We're stronger when we work together." —Kingpin
name: Organized Crime
text: Each minion gets +2 hit points.

name: Bag of Tricks
text:
When Revealed: Reveal a random card from your set-aside nemesis set. If no card is revealed this way, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: Give this character a random card from your set-aside nemesis set as an additional boost card.

name: Unrelenting Hate
text:
When Revealed: Your nemesis minion activates against you. If your nemesis minion is not in play, find it and reveal it. If you cannot find it, find an [[Underling]] minion that is not in play and reveal it.
[star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, it gains overkill.

name: Mystic Incursion
text: Uses (2 civilian counters). Hero Action: Spend [mental] [mental] resources or exhaust a hero or ally you control → remove 1 civilian counter from here (2 counters instead if you exhausted a [[Mystic]] character).

name: Sinking Ferry
text: Uses (2 civilian counters). Hero Action: Spend [energy] [energy] resources or exhaust a hero or ally you control → remove 1 civilian counter from here (2 counters instead if you exhausted an [[Aerial]] character).

name: Towering Inferno
text: Uses (2 civilian counters). Hero Action: Spend [physical] [physical] resources or exhaust a hero or ally you control → remove 1 civilian counter from here (2 counters instead if you exhausted a character that has a tough status card).

name: Collapsing Bridge
text: [star] Hinder 2[per_hero]. Forced Response: After any amount of threat is removed from Collapsing Bridge, place 1 threat here.

name: Bystanders in Peril
text:
Peril. When Revealed: Place 1 civilian counter on a [[Disaster]] environment. If no counter was placed this way, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Disaster]] environment and reveal it.
[star] Boost: Place 1 civilian counter on a [[Disaster]] environment.

flavor: "Stop right there!"
name: Cop
text: Quickstrike. Vulnerable. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Cop would scheme, it attacks the villain instead. When Defeated: Place 2 threat on the main scheme.

name: Crooked Cop
text:
Quickstrike. Vulnerable. When Defeated: The defeating player deals themself 1 facedown encounter card.
[star] Boost: Take 2 indirect damage.

name: Wanted
text: Hero Action: Discard cards from the encounter deck until a [[Police]] minion is discarded and put it into play engaged with you. Discard this card.

flavor: "Stand back! This is a crime scene." —Police officer
name: Police Cordon
text: [star] Hinder 1[per_hero]. Each [[Police]] minion gains guard and patrol. When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Police]] minion and reveal it.

name: Sports Car
text: Attach to the enemy with the highest ATK without a [[Vehicle]] attachment. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Forced Interrupt: When attached character would take any amount of damage, place it here instead. If there is 4 or more damage here, discard this card.

name: Motorcycle
text: Attach to the enemy with the highest SCH without a [[Vehicle]] attachment. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Forced Interrupt: When attached character would take any amount of damage, place it here instead. If there is 3 or more damage here, discard this card.

name: Utility Van
text: Attach to the enemy with the fewest remaining hit points without a [[Vehicle]] attachment. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Forced Interrupt: When attached character would take any amount of damage, place it here instead. If there is 6 or more damage here, discard this card.

name: Traffic Jam
text: [star] Hinder 2[per_hero]. Forced Interrupt: When a character with a [[Vehicle]] attachment would: • Add threat to a scheme, that threat is added here instead. • Remove threat from a scheme, that threat is removed from here instead.

name: Carjacking
text: When Revealed: Discard cards from the encounter deck until a [[Vehicle]] attachment is discarded and reveal it. If your identity does not have a [[Vehicle]] attachment, you may spend 3 resources of the same type to attach the discarded attachment to your identity instead.

flavor: "We're fighting on my home turf: the sky!" —The Owl
name: Flight Serum
text: Attach to a non-[[Aerial]] enemy. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Attached enemy gains [[Aerial]]. Hero Action: Discard an [[Attack]] event from your hand → discard this card.

flavor: "No one laughs at Mister Fish!"
name: Mister Fish
text: [star] Mister Fish's attacks gain piercing and ranged. When Revealed: Mister Fish engages the player whose identity has the fewest remaining hit points.

name: The Owl
text:
Quickstrike. [star] The Owl's attacks gain piercing.
[star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, it gains piercing.

name: Swoop Down
text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): The villain and each minion engaged with you schemes. Each [[Aerial]] enemy gets +2 SCH for its activation. When Revealed (Hero): The villain and each minion engaged with you attacks you. Each [[Aerial]] enemy gets +2 ATK for its activation.

flavor: "I'll get him to talk." —Tombstone
name: Cold as Ice
text: Attach to the minion with the highest base hit points and give that minion a tough status card. Otherwise, this card gains surge. [star] Forced Response: After attached minion schemes, confuse the first player's identity and discard Cold as Ice.

name: Hard as Marble
text: Attach to the minion with the highest base hit points and give that minion a tough status card. Otherwise, this card gains surge. [star] Forced Response: After attached minion attacks, stun the attacked character and discard Hard as Marble.

name: Beetle
text: Villainous. When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for an attachment that can attach to a minion and attach it to Beetle.

flavor: "End of the day, this is what I love: a great fight!"
name: Tombstone
text:
Quickstrike.
[star] Boost: Give the villain a tough status card.

name: Hit List
text: Forced Response: After the villain phase begins, deal 3 indirect damage to the first player. For each ally defeated this way, remove 1[per_hero] threat from Hit List.

name: Ivan Banionis
text: Teamwork ([[Tracksuit]]). When Revealed: Place 1 acceleration token here. [star] Forced Response: After Ivan Banionis schemes, place 1 acceleration token here.

name: The Clown
text: Teamwork ([[Tracksuit]]). Villainous. [star] Forced Response: After The Clown schemes, give him 1 facedown boost card.

name: Tracksuit Mafioso
text: Retaliate 2. Teamwork ([[Tracksuit]]). Vulnerable. When Defeated: Tuck this card under the Tracksuit Mafia side scheme. Otherwise, stun and confuse the character that defeated Tracksuit Mafioso.

flavor: "BRO!"
name: Tracksuit Bro
text: Teamwork ([[Tracksuit]]). Vulnerable. When Defeated: Tuck this card under the Tracksuit Mafia side scheme. Otherwise, shuffle this card into the encounter deck.

name: Tracksuit Mafia
text: When Revealed: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Tracksuit]] minion is discarded and tuck that minion here. Forced Response: After a player reveals a [[Tracksuit]] minion from the encounter deck, that player reveals 1 minion tucked here.
